comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment:
We need to solve our problems with bad drivers in Southern Utah. I am tired of seeing collisions every day of the week. I am afraid for my life and lives of my family just getting on our roads. Our traffic Police are doing a terrible job of issuing tickets and holding bad drivers accountable. A large portion of accidents in this town are due to red light runners. 100% of every signal stop people run the red light. Why? There is ZERO accountability. I propose placing traffic cameras at every light to catch red light runners and mail them tickets. If citizens knew they were getting a ticket for running the light, they wouldn't do it. No one thinks they will cause a wreck if they chance it, but if they knew 100% no question they had to pay a fine it would make an impact. IN ADDITION, police need to actually write tickets and not let people go with warnings. ZERO tolerance for distracted drivers. If they are seen on the phone, they get a ticket. No questions asked.

I appreciate listening to my concerns. If we take a proactive approach to law enforcement we would save countless lives and actually protect our citizens.

Thank you
